nom: Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Hydrating Bi-Phase Tonic

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-to-normal skin report the toner hydrates without weighing skin down, absorbs well, and helps with oiliness (better than a rosewater spray, per one comparison to Rhode).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dry/mature and dry/sensitive combinations, describe strong relief especially in cold or dry weather, calling it a serum-and-moisturizer-in-one.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-acne-prone and combination-sensitive, report no greasy feel and note improvements in tone, breakouts, and redness within about two weeks.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive, hypersensitive, and reactive-skin reviewers most often describe the toner as calming and non-irritating, though one reviewer with unspecified skin reports slight irritation and no hydration benefit.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report firmer, plumper, more radiant skin and describe visible reduction in fine lines after regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing normal-to-oily skin reports a hydrating, glowing effect with good absorption and no irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report reduced crow's feet, firmer and plumper skin, and a more radiant, youthful look with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: This is the most frequently reported benefit: reviewers across skin types describe strong, non-heavy hydration, a dewy or plump finish, and reduced dryness even in winter or dry climates; one reviewer found it not hydrating at all for her skin.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers, including those with rosacea, reactive skin, and general redness, report visible calming and reduction of redness; no dissenting reports of increased redness appear.
concerns.barrier: A small number of reviewers report improved barrier feel, describing skin as calmer and less reactive to acids or retinoids after incorporating the toner.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne scars or uneven pigmentation report visibly reduced pigmentation and more even tone, in one case after a single use.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and, in one case, reduced breakouts alongside better tone; no reviewer reports the toner causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the toner hydrates without adding grease or heaviness, describing a lightweight, non-oily finish.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under serums and moisturizer
Glass bottle and packaging seen as luxurious
High price point for a toner

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try because of all the great reviews but unfortunately I didn't find this to be hydrating or moisturizing at all. It also slightly irritates my skin once applied. It just didn't work for my skin.

extraits.titre: Hydrating, gentle, and easy to use
extraits.texte: This is a really nice everyday toner. I like the bi-phase formula and how it feels once shaken and applied — hydrating, calming, and not heavy at all. My skin feels comfortable right away, not tight or sticky. It's gentle, layers well, and doesn't irritate my dry, sensitive skin. However If you use too much, it can feel a little rich, especially if you're layering several products. Also the price is on the higher side for a toner. that's more about hydration and comfort than visible results.

This is heavenly! I bought 2 so I have a backup, and will probably buy a 3rd today for the Anniversary sale. This is great for my combo skin. It doesn't leave it greasy feeling, in 2 weeks time I have seen improvements in skin tone, breakouts, and redness. I also have noticed my skin is not getting as irritated from acids and my Tretinoin-tho I am not sure if that is from the Toner. I'm just praying Bloomeffects keeps this once the Sarah Palmeri Limited Edition ones are gone. It's my second fav Bloomeffects product.

This toner is the real deal. It's not just like spritzing rose water on your face. If you have sensitive or dry skin or just picky/red/irritated skin due to whatever, this could be your best friend. I put it in my palm and pat it on my face. I let it mostly dry before moisturizer. I think it really helps reduce redness and balances and gives light moisture. Kind of silently magical!

I've never tried anything from this brand but love Sarah and her content so I had to buy and support her. WOW I'm combo, acne prone, sensitive skin and this toner really is a serum, toner, and if you're not dry a moisturizer (during the day!)

I have very problematic skin with acne scars, uneven tone, and dull skin. I tried this bi toner for one night and woke up with VISIBLY less pigmentation on my cheeks from acne and glowing hydrated skin. I highly recommend for everyday use:)

My dry mature skin loves this tonic. I am extremely sensitive and fight redness from rosacea but using this tonic, especially with the royal jelly, my skin looks healthy and hydrated and ten years younger.
